    • queuePlayer

      public abstract boolean queuePlayer(org.bukkit.entity.Player player, String ladder, boolean ranked, boolean keepInventoryOpen)
      Queue the player for a ladder, like the queue menu does. The player gets the usual queue messages. Already queued for the ladder: nothing changes. Main thread only.
      Parameters:
      player - The player
      ladder - The ladder name
      ranked - true for the ranked queue, false for unranked
      keepInventoryOpen - Keep the player's open inventory open, only applies with multi-queue
      Returns:
      true if the player is queued for the ladder or a match started right away; false if the player has no loaded profile, is not in the lobby or a queue, is in staff mode or a party, the ladder is unknown, disabled, frozen or unranked-only for a ranked queue, or a queue requirement failed
      Since:
      2.7.0
